test_rules: Every test has a frozen configuration identity, test script, precondition, instrument/channel identity and stop criterion.
Fault injection must be bounded and performed only in a reviewed unoccupied test cell with secondary containment and safe residual route.
Never inject contamination or hazardous chemical agents without a separately approved hazard and disposal plan.
Never create a potable/non-potable cross-connection, even as a test; verify separation using approved professional test methods.
Any critical unknown, stale or conflicting quality/metrology evidence must result in no product-release credit.
Each test records whether the fail-safe state was actually observed, its latency, any leakage/overflow, and restoration/recommissioning evidence.
These are test scenarios and target outcomes, not evidence that the system currently passes.

scenarios.name: Loss of mains/electrical power
preconditions: test_cell unoccupied
approved backup/safe drain route available
treatment train in frozen baseline state
scenarios.injection: Remove normal supply to the selected treatment/control circuit using an approved isolated test method.
expected_state: powered treatment stops safely
reuse release closes or remains inhibited
raw and treated inventories remain physically segregated
protected mains fallback is unaffected
scenarios.recovery: Restore power, complete restart checks and verify process barrier readiness before release.
scenarios.acceptance: Safe state observed on every trial; no unqualified release; recovery only after re-admission.

scenarios.name: UV barrier/lamp unavailable
preconditions: UV barrier is selected and installed
validated flow/UVT/irradiance monitoring method exists
scenarios.injection: Simulate lamp fault or barrier-not-ready condition using manufacturer-approved test interface; do not disable UV and allow flow to a live use outlet.
expected_state: release interlock denies product release for uses requiring UV
water remains quarantined or is diverted to approved residual route
fault event is logged
prohibited_outcomes: reuse while dose state is unknown
scenarios.recovery: Correct fault, perform barrier proof test and required sample/process verification before re-admission.
scenarios.acceptance: Every seeded unready state blocks release.

scenarios.name: UV sensor stale or unadmitted
preconditions: critical UV measurand mapped to Mycelix instrument/channel identity
scenarios.injection: Freeze timestamp or invalidate test measurement admission in a synthetic/safe test mode.
expected_state: measurement marked unadmitted
release inhibited
no last-good value silently carried forward
scenarios.recovery: Restore valid channel/timebase/calibration evidence and complete interlock reset procedure.
scenarios.acceptance: No release while critical measurement is stale/unadmitted.

scenarios.name: Membrane integrity failure
preconditions: UF module selected; approved non-contaminating integrity-test method available
scenarios.injection: Apply validated integrity-test challenge or approved simulator input without feeding a compromised product to use outlet.
expected_state: membrane module isolated
product outlet blocked/quarantined
feed routed to approved reject/hold path
prohibited_outcomes: membrane bypass with continued service credit
manual software override without independent proof
scenarios.recovery: Repair/replace membrane, perform integrity test and recommission process before release.
scenarios.acceptance: Every failed/indeterminate integrity test blocks product release.

scenarios.name: High turbidity / feed out of admitted envelope
preconditions: declared challenge envelope and test method frozen
safe batch containment present
scenarios.injection: Introduce a safe, non-hazardous feed challenge only within the separately approved test protocol or replay a synthetic sensor signal.
expected_state: source batch is not admitted or process diversion is triggered
batch identity retained
treatment not credited outside its declared envelope
scenarios.recovery: Return to admitted source conditions, clean/inspect as specified, and re-qualify.
scenarios.acceptance: Out-of-envelope feed cannot create an admitted product result.

scenarios.name: Raw equalisation tank high level / overflow
preconditions: overflow route inspected and approved
scenarios.injection: Raise level using measured safe water inflow to predefined test threshold.
expected_state: inflow isolated or diverted
overflow follows dedicated approved route
no overflow into building or potable infrastructure
prohibited_outcomes: cross-contamination between raw and treated tanks
scenarios.recovery: Lower level, identify cause, inspect tank/route, reset with recorded event.

scenarios.name: Treated quarantine tank high level
preconditions: quarantine tank not connected to use without release interlock
scenarios.injection: Raise treated tank level to the declared high threshold using admitted test water.
expected_state: upstream feed stops or diverts
release remains governed only by valid admission
overflow has a dedicated approved route
scenarios.recovery: Restore normal level and verify sample/age status before release.
scenarios.acceptance: No unmeasured overflow or release bypass.

scenarios.name: Pump failure / dry-run / overpressure
preconditions: pump, pressure boundary and protection limits independently reviewed
scenarios.injection: Use controlled manufacturer-approved simulation or isolated test fixture; do not dead-head an unprotected pump.
expected_state: pump stops or protective trip occurs
reuse release is isolated if delivery envelope is lost
gravity fallback only remains available if separately designed and admitted
prohibited_outcomes: claim of service under failed flow/pressure floor
scenarios.recovery: Repair, pressure/flow check, dry-run protection proof and requalification.
scenarios.acceptance: Protection operates within approved design limits; no uncontrolled discharge.

scenarios.name: GAC breakthrough / media identity unknown
preconditions: GAC module selected with target analytes and breakthrough method
scenarios.injection: Use a safe reference/test solution or simulated limit event from approved analytical method.
expected_state: module output not admitted after endpoint
release blocks or diverts
media identity and replacement event recorded
scenarios.recovery: Replace media, verify lot and commissioning, run required analytical check.

scenarios.name: Ozone off-gas / residual safety fault
preconditions: ozone module selected and specific hazard review/monitoring installed
scenarios.injection: Only an approved non-emitting sensor simulation unless a qualified hazardous-process test procedure exists.
expected_state: ozone generation de-energizes
process feed isolated
off-gas handling remains safe
no output release
prohibited_outcomes: oxidant residual unknown at product boundary
scenarios.recovery: Qualified inspection, gas-free/measurement proof, repair and recommissioning.
scenarios.acceptance: All detected or unknown safety states stop generation and block release.

scenarios.name: Communications/cloud loss
preconditions: local deterministic control and manual safe operating procedure available
scenarios.injection: Disconnect external network/telemetry while local control remains powered.
expected_state: local safety logic continues deterministically
no remote dependency for safe shutdown/hold
loss of remote observability is recorded
scenarios.recovery: Restore connection and reconcile events without retroactive quality admission.
scenarios.acceptance: No change to safe-state behaviour; no cloud-required safety dependency.

scenarios.name: Conflicting or stale quality evidence
preconditions: sample/result identities bound to source batch, time and use profile
scenarios.injection: Seed a stale, mismatched-batch or contradictory quality assessment in a test-only data fixture.
expected_state: assessment is Indeterminate or Rejected
release inhibited
no quality evidence is reassigned to a different batch
prohibited_outcomes: average conflicting values into a pass
AI reconciliation treated as lab assessment
scenarios.recovery: Acquire correct sample/evidence and independent assessment; re-evaluate exact batch.
scenarios.acceptance: Any stale/identity conflict blocks use credit.

scenarios.name: Timebase / event identity mismatch
preconditions: instrument streams and controller events synchronized under admitted timebase
scenarios.injection: Seed a time offset, duplicate timestamp or mismatched event identity in a test fixture.
expected_state: affected evidence marked unadmitted
service or quality claim abstains where temporal linkage is critical
prohibited_outcomes: join samples to wrong process batch
scenarios.recovery: Correct clock and replay/reconcile source event trail.
scenarios.acceptance: Mismatched event-time identity never earns product credit.

scenarios.name: Power restoration / process restart
preconditions: power-loss state tested; restart protocol frozen
scenarios.injection: Restore supply after a controlled interruption while product remains quarantined.
expected_state: start-up sequence checks barriers, tank age and sample validity
release remains inhibited until all required checks pass
recovery time recorded
prohibited_outcomes: automatic release on power restoration alone
old sample treated as valid after storage/process change
scenarios.recovery: Complete documented restart, cleaning and proof-test actions; independently re-admit.
scenarios.acceptance: Release only after all required recovery checks.

scenarios.name: Source cross-mix / wrong source connector
preconditions: source connectors physically keyed/labelled; isolated test fixture
scenarios.injection: Seed incorrect source ID in a simulated input or use an inert non-contaminating labelled fluid in a test rig.
expected_state: batch retains true identity or becomes unadmitted
incompatible source cannot silently enter a different source train
scenarios.recovery: Isolate, drain/clean according to reviewed procedure and reinspect keyed interface.

scenarios.name: Nature-based cell clogging / short circuit
preconditions: wetland module selected and instrumented for level/flow distribution
scenarios.injection: Apply a bounded hydraulic-loading challenge within approved limits or simulate differential level/flow response.
expected_state: performance outside hydraulic envelope causes module isolation or diversion
clogging/short-circuit evidence logged
prohibited_outcomes: nominal throughput assumed while residence distribution fails
scenarios.recovery: Inspect/maintain media and re-establish hydraulic performance before output admission.
scenarios.acceptance: Declared hydraulic failure is detected and no unsupported treatment claim is made.

global_acceptance: Every seeded critical fault reaches its specified safe state in every valid trial.
Zero release occurs while a required barrier, quality admission or critical measurement is unknown/failed.
No potable/nonpotable cross-connection is created or tolerated.
All source, product, reject, purge, backwash, overflow and drain flows are reconciled within the admitted metrology uncertainty.
Each failed trial retains the configuration, event, sample and instrument identity; no failed run is hidden.
explicit_nonclaims: This matrix does not qualify any safety interlock or hardware component.
Fault injection is not authorised until the test-cell owner and relevant professionals approve the method.
No contaminated or hazardous challenge fluid may be used without a separately approved handling and disposal plan.
